Combine Skyrim's serious grounded physicality, credible scale and weathered material realism with League of Legends' rich controlled colors, strong silhouettes and readable designed shape language. Push colorful stylized realism: grounded anatomy and construction, with conspicuously curated saturated color masses and slightly exaggerated bevels, graceful sweeping silhouettes and clustered foliage shapes. This is NOT a copy of any existing game character, location, logo or symbol. Mature believable fantasy, no cartoon, no anime, no chibi, no plastic toy materials, no photobashed muddy gray scene. Clear sculptable primary forms, defined secondary forms, restrained fine detail. Stone, pigmented earth, dark wood, aged iron and bronze, ceramic and dyed cloth. Emerald/teal vegetation, ochre and terracotta architecture, muted cobalt cloth, warm amber lights; saturation used in controlled focal accents. Detailed physically plausible rendered surfaces with art-directed simplification, as if an exquisite hand-authored high-quality 3D game; clearly colorful and designed, neither photographic nor loose watercolor. All design details are visual proposals; do not imply official named kingdoms, fixed classes or solved cosmology. No text, captions, title, logos, watermarks or UI unless explicitly requested.
One landscape 3:2 weapons production design sheet on pale neutral background, five clearly separated vertical columns. Exactly FIVE weapon families from left to right: one practical one-handed SWORD; a PAIR of articulated battle GAUNTLETS with actual finger plates and wrist straps; one short flanged MACE; one grounded single-bladed AXE; a PAIR of compact DAGGERS. Each column contains its full main item, a smaller side/reverse view, and a small grip or connection detail below. Items are laid out cleanly with every tip, grip and finger visible, no overlap, no crop. Unified original design language: tempered steel/aged iron darkened in recesses, worn bronze narrow reinforcing bands, dark wood, brown leather bindings, small saturated cobalt cloth strips. Solid physically functional thickness, sensible balance, sculptable beveled primary planes, practical hand grips sized coherently; beautiful designed silhouettes with controlled fantasy curves. No giant toy blades, no neon magic, no copied game weapon, no shield. Perfectly neutral diffuse lighting, shadows only beneath objects, no labels or text, avoid decorative borders.

assets.title: Arsenal II — alcance e impacto
assets.subject: One landscape 3:2 weapon modeling concept sheet, FIVE carefully spaced vertical columns on pale neutral studio background. Exactly these five weapon families from left to right: long SPEAR with credible small leaf-shaped steel head; fantasy combat SCYTHE with long curved blade joined visibly to reinforced wood shaft (experimental form, not a canonical historical weapon); long-handled WAR HAMMER with compact dense hammer head; recurve BOW with clearly continuous taut bowstring between both limb tips plus one arrow resting beside it; CROSSBOW with readable bow limbs, continuous string across limbs, stock, tiller, groove and mechanical trigger. Every full shaft and tip is inside frame, generous margins. Below each weapon, one larger close-up of its structural join or gripping mechanism. Same coherent materials as a grounded original fantasy world: weathered dark wood, brushed aged steel, restrained bronze collar fittings, practical leather, small cobalt wrapping accents. Strong individually distinct silhouettes, credible functional construction, controlled stylized realism and rich materials, no oversized cartoon heads. Orthographic-like presentation rather than dramatic action, soft diffuse lighting. No text, numbers, labels, symbols or watermark.
assets.note: Da esquerda para a direita: lança, foice, martelo de guerra, arco e besta. Famílias registradas na p.23; função da foice em aberto. Desenhos são propostas visuais.

assets.title: Montaria de carga e arreios
assets.subject: One landscape 3:2 creature-and-tack modeling turnaround sheet. Design ONE original prehistoric-inspired quadruped herbivorous PACK MOUNT, medium horse-size but much more barrel-chested, sturdy columnar yet flexible legs, broad blunt beaked snout, a low armored brow crest without huge combat horns, thick tapering tail, muted slate-teal pebbled skin fading to warm gray belly, anatomically plausible weight and joints. Creature calm and domestically handled, no aggressive expression. Main large true side view facing left occupies upper half, with same-specimen smaller front and rear views beside it aligned at feet. Every view has matching proportions and FOUR total legs. Functional removable dark brown leather and ochre woven-fabric pack saddle padded to avoid spine pressure, two balanced detachable cargo panniers, secure straps around chest and belly, no straps through flesh, no huge overload. Lower row separated: saddle frame/padding; paired closed panniers; rolled blanket/rope and clasp detail; small bare side silhouette without gear clarifying anatomy. Neutral pale gray background, soft studio light, no scenic environment. Controlled colorful stylized realism, detailed believable hide/leather/weave but strong planes and readable silhouettes. This specific species is an optional visual proposal, not an established creature from the source. No rider, no text, no labels.
assets.note: Montarias pré-históricas são uma possibilidade do PDF. Espécie e arreios são propostas; o papel de carga já aparece como proposta funcional.

assets.title: O Livro e o kit de jornada
assets.subject: One landscape 3:2 prop modeling production sheet on a clean warm-neutral studio background. Main hero object is an ORIGINAL physical interpretation of a character's biographical BOOK, a proposal derived from the source's memory system, no asserted magical power. A weathered deep teal leather codex with dark wood cover boards beneath leather, aged bronze reinforced corners, one simple functional clasp, visible sewn spine, five muted cloth section ribbons. Show SAME book in three clear views: closed three-quarter, fully open with thick lightly used parchment and only faint nonverbal small sketch marks, rear/spine detail; every view consistent and non-overlapping. No legible text or magical runes. Below, five separate complementary travel items displayed cleanly: waxed canvas shoulder bag; leather tool roll open with small repair tools; three ceramic sealed alchemy containers in leather holder; bronze handheld astronomical sighting ring with mechanical joints; rope-bound cloth parcel with paper tag left blank. All physically manufacturable and usable, correct clasp hinges and book page block, no glowing floating pages, no religious or faction sigils. Rich cobalt/teal leather and amber bronze, mature material realism and designed stylized shape readability. Soft diffuse light, no dramatic shadows, no labels.
assets.note: O Livro é um sistema de memória na base; sua materialização física e os desenhos dos objetos são propostas visuais.

assets.title: Oito expressões de magia
assets.subject: One landscape 3:2 art direction reference sheet, EIGHT equally sized panels in a precise FOUR-COLUMN by TWO-ROW grid. Dark neutral gray background, clean spacious gutters, no written headings. Each panel has one centered clearly defined isolated phenomenon over a small matching stone disc and provides a distinct SHAPE grammar as well as color. Top row left to right: 1 WATER/ICE as a fluid cobalt ribbon passing into angular translucent ice facets; 2 FIRE/LAVA as two compact orange flame tongues over dark cooled crust with small glowing red cracks, no smoke cloud; 3 NATURE as three curving sculptable living roots with broad emerald leaves forming a protective open arch; 4 WIND/AIR as two translucent pale spirals that visibly bend a few leaves with no dense white tornado. Bottom row left to right: 5 CURSES as asymmetrical dark plum hooked wisps and a clear broken-ring stain, no occult writing; 6 METAMORPHOSIS as ONE complete serious anatomically plausible brown bear in grounded side three-quarter stance, full four legs and paws visible, a faint dissolving humanoid outline behind it only to communicate transformation, no fused extra limbs; 7 HEALING/VITAL as a compact warm coral-gold pulse with interwoven organic arcs around a simplified hand silhouette; 8 SACRED as an ivory-gold clean faceted protective arch and gentle radial light, WITHOUT crosses, deity, named religious symbol or specified cosmology. Each effect stays entirely inside its own cell. Rich luminous color but restrained bloom preserving crisp silhouettes and forms. Study of visual grammar for 3D/VFX, not icons or class selection UI. Consistent material rendering, mature colorful semi-realism, no text, no labels, no logos.
assets.note: Linha superior, da esquerda: água/gelo, fogo/lava, natureza e vento/ar. Linha inferior: maldições, metamorfose, cura/vital e sagrada. Linhas registradas no adendo; formas e cores são propostas. O urso é inspiração temática.
